'''Rustomjee Academy for Global Careers''' is a private [[vocational education and training]] (VET) institute.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://abpmajha.abplive.in/topic/dahanu-rustomjee-academy-hotel-managment-students-prepared-100-ft-long-pizza|title=Dahanu Rustomjee Academy Hotel Management Students Prepared 100 Ft Long Pizza|website=abpmajha.abplive.in|access-date=7 May 2019}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.thehighereducationreview.com/magazine/rustomjee-academy-for-global-careers-enhancing-the-employability-quotient-of-young-india-NTDV968199170.html|title=Rustomjee Academy For Global Careers: Enhancing The Employability Quotient Of Young India|website=www.thehighereducationreview.com|access-date=7 May 2019}}</ref> The institute is located on four campuses across [[Dahanu]], [[Thane]], [[Bengaluru]] and [[Rishikesh]] in India. It was established in 2008.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.thehighereducationreview.com/magazine/rustomjee-academy-for-global-careers-enhancing-the-employability-quotient-of-young-india-NTDV968199170.html|title=Rustomjee Academy For Global Careers: Enhancing The Employability Quotient Of Young India|website=www.thehighereducationreview.com|access-date=6 May 2019}}</ref>

==History==
Rustomjee Academy for Global Careers was established in 2008 as a [[corporate social responsibility]] initiative of the Rustomjee Group, a [[real estate developer]] in [[Mumbai]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.hunarr.co.in/institute/rustomjee-academy-for-global-careers/|title=Rustomjee Academy for Global Careers in Thane West, Thane – Hunarr.co.in|last=Hunarr|website=Hunarr|access-date=6 May 2019}}</ref> Since its inception, RAGC has trained over 100,000 students.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://csrbox.org/India_organization_Maharashtra-Rustomjee-Academy-for-Global-Careers_2544|title=Rustomjee Academy for Global Careers-Maharashtra- CSR Organization profile|website=csrbox.org|access-date=6 May 2019}}</ref>

==Accreditation and partnerships==
Rustomjee Academy for Global Careers is affiliated with Maharashtra State Board of Vocational Education Examination, [[Yashwantrao Chavan Maharashtra Open University]], [[University of Wolverhampton]] and [[Pearson International|Pearson]]. The institute has also partnered with the [[National Skill Development Corporation]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://content.magicbricks.com/property-news/industry-buzz/mumbai-industry-buzz/rustomjee-group-signs-mou-with-nsdc-to-skill-workforce/89350.html|title=Rustomjee Group signs MoU with NSDC to skill workforce|website=content.magicbricks.com|access-date=6 May 2019}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www.indiatoday.in/pti-feed/story/national-skills-development-corporation-appoints-credai-626855-2016-06-17|title=National Skills Development Corporation Appoints CREDAI|date=17 June 2016|agency=P. T. I.|website=India Today|language=en|access-date=7 May 2019}}</ref>

==Campus==
[[File:Rustomjee Academy for Global Careers.png|thumb|Rustomjee Academy for Global Careers|318x318px]]
'''RAGC Dahanu''': It was started in 2012 and affiliated to Maharashtra State Board of Vocational Education Examination (MSBVEE) in 2013. The campus is expanded in 5 acres located in [[Dahanu]] East. It offers full-time / part time programs in automobile, electronics, business, construction, and hospitality management.

'''RAGC Thane''': Founded in 2014, Thane campus of RAGC is located in the industrial zone of [[Wagle Estate]]. It offers Full-Time Programs in [[Automobile]], Electrical, Construction, and Business and offers Part-Time Programs in Multi-Skill Technician – ELBS, Construction Site Supervisor, and Automotive Mechanic.

'''RAGC Bengaluru''': Rustomjee Academy for Global Careers partnered with [[Prestige Group]], as a part of Skill India Mission, to set up the Rustomjee Prestige Vocational Education and Training Centre in [[Bengaluru]], in 2017.<ref>{{Cite news|url=https://www.thehindu.com/life-and-style/homes-and-gardens/for-the-right-home-building-skills/article19644869.ece|title=For the right home building skills|date=8 September 2017|work=The Hindu|access-date=6 May 2019|language=en-IN|issn=0971-751X}}</ref> The campus offers corporate training to employees in Mechanical and Electrical sector. It also offers higher national diploma in construction and the built environment accredited by Pearson.[[File:Automobile Lab at Rustomjee Academy for Global Careers, Dahanu.jpg|alt=Automobile Lab at RAGC Dahanu|thumb|321x321px|Automobile Laboratory at Rustomjee Academy for Global Careers, Dahanu]]

'''RAGC Rishikesh''':  RAGC partnered with Shri. Swami Purnanand Vidya Niketan Samiti to start a centre in [[Rishikesh]] in 2018. It offers short term vocational training courses for [[Pastry Chef]] and Multi Skilled Technician.

== Academic departments ==
The institute has 4 academic departments offering certificate, diploma and degree programs. These are:

* [[Automotive engineering|Automobile Engineering]] Department
* Civil and [[Construction engineering]] Department
* [[Electronics]] and [[Telecommunications engineering|Tele-Communication Engineering]] Department
* Management & [[Entrepreneurship]] Department

== Impact ==

=== Social ===
Skill Cluster, a division of Rustomjee Academy for Global Careers was started in 2015 with an aim to take the benefit of vocational skills to the masses for immediate employment. Skill Cluster has been supported by [[National Skill Development Corporation]], Maharashtra State Skill Development Society, Uttarakhand Skill Development Mission, Tourism Corporation of Gujarat Limited and Confederation of Real Estate Developers Association of India.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://credai.org/press-releases/credai-hosted-the-convocation-ceremony-of-its-first-all-women-masons-batch-in-chhattisgarh|title=Press Releases – CREDAI {{!}} CREDAI|website=credai.org|access-date=14 May 2019}}</ref>

=== Corporate ===
Rustomjee Academy for Global Careers Corporate Training Program was introduced to support industry members by providing gainful skill training to their existing/new employees.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.nationalskillsnetwork.in/ragc-rpl-convocation-2/|title=Rustomjee Academy for Global Careers (RAGC) holds RPL Convocation|date=30 June 2017|website=National Skills Network|language=en-US|access-date=14 May 2019}}</ref>
